// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// Owner decision D9, made structural: `correctAdultEmail` does not exist, in
// any form, for staff or for parents. Change the address, trigger a sign-in
// email, become that person, reach that class's children. Every step is a
// legitimate operation, which is why no gate can catch the SEQUENCE - so the
// gate catches the first step instead.
//
// This is why the rotation permission matches one `data:` shape rather than
// permitting `parent.update` in the operations module. A broad permission would
// have left this one keystroke away, in the file most likely to be trusted.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function fixTypo(parentId, corrected) {
  await db.parent.update({
    where: { id: parentId },
    data: { email: corrected },
    select: { id: true },
  });
}
